name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
description:
About This Game

Your evil Dragon Ex has stolen your stuff! And she ran alllll the way to the bottom of the dungeon, even though she KNOWS you can't fight very well... ugh!

Well, not to worry! You've got... erhm, actually basically no skills in your repertoire. What's a hopeless adventurer to do? Ask that really pretty Slime Girl over there for help? Surely fluttering your eyelashes won't change anything... unless?

Play as Taffy, a hopeless weakling flirt who dives into a sprawling dungeon full of Monster Girls with WAY too much personality. Build relationships, survive battles (mostly thanks to them), and try not to make your party jealous- or worse, sulking.

Dungeon-Crawling = Meet-Cute, Right?

Fighting is hard, so Flirt instead! Recruit Monster Girls into your party by Rizzing them up, a declaration so bold that it can melt even the iciest Monster Girl's heart... provided you don't fumble at the last minute.

Friends With Benefits (The Benefits Are Fighting For Me)

After recruiting a Monster Girl to your side with your overflowing Rizz, they'll join your party... full of other Monster Girls. Manage their personalities as they fight for you, giving them all juuust the right amount and kind of attention... or else they might start fighting each other!

Girls' Nights!

After a long day of dungeon delving, unwind at the Inn with Sleepovers; quiet moments with a chosen Monster Girl where you can talk, learn lore, and make meaningful choices that draw you closer to them... or don't. It's your heart on the line!

Trinkets, Flasks, and Fishsticks?!

Collect trinkets to help manage your Monster Girls, grab mysterious flasks for buffs, and trade fishsticks with the mysterious Bartender to gain more Knowledge about the Monster Girls you encounter.

Featuring:

⦁ Dozens of Rizz-able Monster Girls

⦁ Relationship-driven Turn-based Combat

⦁ Five unique Dungeons to Crawl

⦁ Four distinct Monster Girl Personalities with Dynamic Interactions

⦁ Sleepover nights to raise Affection

⦁ One (Unfortunately Hot) (Unfortunately Super Strong) Dragon Ex-Girlfriend
short_desc: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?
